scope: Lane 10: distinct, public-source general reverse-engineering/decompilation tools, build-matching helpers, static recompiler frameworks, and non-game/embedded emulation frameworks. projects.source_available: Public MIT-licensed source repository; game ROMs, system ROMs, and generated C are not included.

projects.status: Experimental; v0.1.0 was released 2026-08-03 and source changes continued through 2026-09-10. The README says a supported exact ROM is required and that generating code does not guarantee every game or scene works; verified compatibility is title-specific.
projects.summary: Static Game Boy/Game Boy Color recompilation toolchain that analyzes banked LR35902 code and emits portable C for a shared desktop runtime. It includes hardware emulation, an interpreter fallback, exact-ROM verification, differential testing, and tooling for native modifications.
projects.strategy: Static LR35902 code analysis and C emission with runtime fallback for unresolved behavior
projects.source_available: Public MIT-licensed source repository; ROM images are not included and must be lawfully supplied by users.

projects.status: Active; latest source push checked 2026-09-26; no tagged release is listed. The README says function boundaries must be known from a decompilation/disassembly or supplied symbol/config data, and recompiled output is run with a separate runtime.
projects.summary: Static Game Boy Advance recompiler that emits C# methods from ROM/ELF code and symbol information. It is a code-generation tool rather than a complete console emulator; a separate GBA Modern Runtime provides execution and hardware services.

projects.source_available: Public MIT-licensed source repository; original ROMs are not included.

projects.title: Box86
projects.game: 32-bit x86 Linux applications (multi-title)
projects.platform: 32-bit x86 Linux applications → non-x86 Linux hosts, especially 32-bit little-endian ARM systems; 32-bit userspace/toolchain required
projects.status: Active source repository; latest source push checked 2026-09-27. Latest tagged release found is v0.3.8 (2024-12-06). The README stresses that 32-bit host userspace and build support are required; this is distinct from the 64-bit Box64 project already cataloged.
projects.summary: User-mode x86 Linux emulator with a dynamic recompiler for running 32-bit x86 programs on compatible non-x86 Linux systems. It uses selected native host libraries such as libc, SDL, and OpenGL; it does not emulate a complete PC.
projects.strategy: Process-level x86 instruction emulation/dynamic recompilation integrated with host Linux libraries
projects.source_available: Public MIT-licensed source repository.
projects.subtype: 32-bit x86 Linux user-mode emulator and dynamic recompiler
